scope: All 64 authored symbolic-head contracts P001-P064; this is not a mapping of the separate 1024-item empirical/research attention inventory.
method: Manual review of each source name, description, required program and ten example feature targets; manual semantic selection of catalog keys; linked IDs/runtime/operations resolved from current source builds.

relation_definitions.adaptation: The principal semantic behavior has a decomposition among linked proposed contracts. This is a reuse route, not implemented runtime parity or a claim of one-to-one equivalence.
relation_definitions.partial: Linked fields/heads cover meaningful components, but the named old behavior requires an additional composition, selection, probability or state mechanism listed in remaining_work.
relation_definitions.no_direct_equivalent: No proposed contract implements the defining mechanism. Any linked fields are supporting inputs only; an empty link list means even a useful specific substitute was not identified.

shared_limits: The old table heads rerank existing next-word grammar candidates through selection/projection/receiver tables. New catalog heads usually add or suppress typed evidence at the current residual query. A final word-and-bundle projection must connect these interfaces; it is not supplied by this crosswalk.

All source and target entries are authored proposals or narrow seeds, not learned empirical mechanisms. Old program_required contracts and new adapter_required contracts remain unimplemented unless separately built and evaluated.

Native means the linked finite matcher/projection seed can execute under its stated input convention. It does not make the entire linked old head native, solve sense/coreference upstream, or establish broad lexical coverage.

Attribute-to-head links are associations, not assumed producer identity. actual_write_fields and head_operations expose revision/suppression contracts that consume the associated field and weaken a different old field.

Read only the visible prefix and causal annotations. Write current-query evidence; do not mutate earlier latents or commit world state from predicted bundles. Preserve entity, event, holder, time, semantic-world and assertion-scope bindings.

No match, absent corpus support, unavailable knowledge, contradictory evidence and nonexistent world facts are different conditions. Missing fields mean unknown; suppressing evidence does not assert a logical opposite.

entries.old_contract: Current clause → grammatical subject → number. Reweight singular/plural verb forms.
entries.explanation: Subject binding and joint agreement requirements decompose the old subject-to-number projection while preserving the distinction between NP node and discourse entity.
remaining_work: Connect the selected subject's number to the next finite-verb candidate; finite morphology seeds alone do not identify the controller.

entries.old_contract: Current finite verb slot → subject's discourse person. Prefer am/is/are as appropriate.
entries.explanation: Person and number requirements cover agreement, while speaker/addressee bindings supply the dialogue anchor required for first and second person.
remaining_work: Resolve quoted person under the active turn and realize person-number bundles as compatible finite forms.

entries.old_contract: Current event → governing temporal frame. Reweight tense-compatible forms.
entries.explanation: The catalog separates overt grammatical tense from event time and the narrative anchor, making the old temporal-frame lookup representable without equating tense with chronology.
remaining_work: Learn or author the anchor-to-tense realization policy, including habitual present, embedded reports and frame shifts; the current finite tense seed is not that policy.

entries.old_contract: Unfinished verb phrase → nearest governing auxiliary. Prefer compatible participles or infinitives.
entries.explanation: Auxiliary-chain analysis and complement requirements provide a structured version of the old auxiliary-to-required-form table.
remaining_work: Implement the declared incremental auxiliary analysis and project its still-open requirement to inflectional candidates; preserve ambiguity of be/have.

entries.old_contract: Unfinished noun phrase → active determiner. Reweight noun forms.
entries.explanation: Determiner kind, nominal countability and agreement constraints cover the components of noun-form completion.
remaining_work: Add the explicit determiner-to-countability/number constraint composition; recognizing a determiner or a noun independently does not implement the old table.

entries.old_contract: Current predicate → its unfilled argument slots. Favor a location or transferred object.
entries.explanation: Open valency slots and an unfilled semantic role reproduce the intended distinction between a missing patient, recipient, PP or predicative complement.
remaining_work: Bind requirements to the selected predicate sense and retain separate frame alternatives rather than inventing unmentioned fillers.

entries.old_contract: After conjunction → first conjunct's structure. Favor a parallel continuation.
entries.explanation: Coordination categories and parallel structures replace the first-conjunct category key with explicit structural constraints.
remaining_work: Compose category and inflection across the selected conjuncts; not every grammatical coordination requires identical surface form.

entries.old_contract: Current prefix → unmatched clause openers. Favor a main clause when still required.
entries.old_required_program: Maintain an incremental clause stack from grammatical derivations; distinguish nested subordinate clauses from completed main clauses.
entries.explanation: Incremental clause status, open scopes and required-structure obligations cover the original stack-based completion contract.
remaining_work: Implement and test the parser/stack adapters on nested subordinate clauses and distinguish an optional extension from an unmet main-clause obligation.

entries.old_contract: Current suffix → earlier matching suffix and successor. Boost observed continuations proportionally.
entries.old_required_program: Index prior token spans and match variable-length current suffixes; count their observed successors without reading future tokens.
entries.explanation: The new retrieval contracts explicitly find prior matching suffixes and visible successors, matching the causal copying component.
remaining_work: Add successor counts, match-length weighting and normalization over all matches; the current list/single-match payloads are not an empirical continuation distribution.

entries.old_contract: Current entity ID → previous surface names. Favor established names over new ones.
entries.old_required_program: Join dynamic entity IDs to their established alias records and scoped mention counts; do not bake names into a global lexical table.
entries.explanation: Entity-bound aliases and naming events cover dynamic name retrieval and distinguish narrator names from a speaker's name.
remaining_work: Add scoped alias mention counts and current-versus-former name ranking; the catalog does not yet produce the old alias-frequency distribution.

entries.old_contract: Current pronoun slot → compatible salient entities. Favor compatible pronouns; retain ambiguity.
entries.old_required_program: Resolve dynamic candidate referents using agreement, salience, binding constraints, and ambiguity; return a distribution, not a fixed pronoun dictionary.
entries.explanation: The reference contracts retain candidate identities, binding constraints and split antecedents rather than using a fixed pronoun table.
remaining_work: Add calibrated candidate probabilities and integrate recency/salience with agreement; an array of compatible entities is not a probability distribution.

entries.old_contract: Current candidate → recent uses and their predicted mass. Reduce excess repetition, without a blanket ban.
entries.old_required_program: Count recent token/lemma usage, compare predicted mass to a baseline, and apply a graded penalty with exemptions for required names or quotations.
entries.explanation: Recurrence and reference/quote fields supply possible inputs, but no new head estimates overprediction relative to a baseline or applies the old graded repetition penalty.
remaining_work: Add model-mass-aware local frequency/decay accounting, lemma grouping and required-name/quotation/function-word exemptions.

entries.old_contract: Ambiguous word → nearby sense-bearing relations. Reweight sense-compatible words.
entries.explanation: Sense candidates, sense IDs and lexical selection preferences provide the target representation for the old finite disambiguation table.
remaining_work: Learn contextual sense selection from relational evidence and calibrate alternatives; several catalog lexical tables require an already selected sense and cannot supply it themselves.

entries.old_contract: Partial established name → remaining name tokens. Favor the remaining name component.
entries.old_required_program: Match partial tokenized names against the active entity registry, preserving shared prefixes, capitalization, and dynamic names.
entries.explanation: The catalog stores names and recognizes a title-name construction, but it has no partial-name trie or dynamic next-component completion contract.
remaining_work: Add tokenized alias indexing, prefix matching and a next-component distribution that preserves shared prefixes, capitalization and entity/scope identity.

entries.old_contract: Current sequence item → configured ordering. Favor a successor in that ordering.
entries.explanation: The ordered-successor contract supplies the same conceptual lookup route, with a declared weekday order as its concrete seed.
remaining_work: Generalize the declared order registry to months, alphabet, seasons and ordinal sequences; retain branching successor distributions where the configured order is not linear.

entries.old_contract: Current passage → recent register-bearing choices. Favor locally compatible diction.
entries.explanation: The catalog identifies register evidence at the expression level and supplies discourse scope, which can feed continuity tracking.
remaining_work: Add passage/turn-scoped aggregation and a diction prior; a local lexical label does not establish the register of an entire passage.

entries.old_contract: Entity-focused query → latest valid location event. Favor grounded location words.
entries.old_required_program: Resolve an entity ID and replay or query its latest committed location, with movement chronology and entity-specific provenance.
entries.explanation: The legacy location materializer explicitly requests the most recent applicable location/holder relation, while world fields retain spatial and motion distinctions.
remaining_work: Implement ordered valid-state selection and preserve world versus reported locations; do not interpret an uncommitted destination candidate as arrival.

entries.old_contract: Object-focused query → latest valid transfer. Favor the current owner.
entries.old_required_program: Replay valid ownership transfers by object ID, distinguishing possession, loans, gifts, return, and failed transfers.
entries.explanation: The possession and transfer contracts distinguish ownership, custody, loans and joint ownership, matching the old transfer-sensitive state query.
remaining_work: Implement object-specific transfer replay with validity and chronology; a handling event alone cannot change ownership.

entries.old_contract: Proposed action → latest state of its patient. Downweight unsupported state-dependent actions.
entries.old_required_program: Read current object properties from committed state and evaluate action-specific compatibility; stale or hypothetical states must not become facts.
entries.explanation: Typed condition candidates and action affordances cover pieces of the old state-dependent compatibility check.
remaining_work: Add latest committed condition selection and a general action-to-precondition join; native adjective seeds are historical interpretation candidates, not a current-world action gate.

entries.old_contract: Object query → nested container relations. Favor reachable containment descriptions.
entries.old_required_program: Traverse typed containment relations with cycle detection, current-state resolution, and holder/location distinctions.
entries.explanation: Containment-path contracts preserve typed relation chains and distinguish containment from support, holder and location relations.
remaining_work: Implement graph traversal with cycle checks, entity identity and latest relation validity; native grammar matching does not traverse an arbitrary graph.

entries.old_contract: Proposed interaction → actor/object positions and barriers. Reweight immediate manipulation versus approach.
entries.old_required_program: Search the spatial/access graph using actor capabilities, barriers, container state, and path costs.
entries.explanation: Actor-specific reachability, barriers and access prerequisites provide a decomposition of the old spatial/access graph query.
remaining_work: Implement feasible-route search with actor/tool capabilities and path costs while retaining unknown routes as unknown.

entries.old_contract: Proposed action → required and available quantities. Favor acquisition or feasible action.
entries.old_required_program: Perform unit-aware resource accounting over inventories and action requirements, reserving shared resources without mutating state during prediction.
entries.explanation: Quantity, reservation and resource-change fields represent the quantities and constraints needed by resource sufficiency.
remaining_work: Add an action-requirement/inventory ledger, shared reservations, unusable-resource filtering and unit-aware deficit computation; the pieces are not yet one sufficiency algorithm.

entries.old_contract: Action query → available tools and typed affordances. Favor an applicable instrument.
entries.explanation: Several explicit affordance contracts and instrument-role binding cover tool suitability without assuming that a mentioned tool is available.
remaining_work: Add action-conditioned ranking over actually available tools and missing affordance families such as painting/stirring; the old table's ten categories are not all distinct new fields.

entries.old_contract: Concept-conditioned query → entities carrying that concept. Favor the carrier's manifestation; emit nothing from an unembedded concept.
entries.old_required_program: Bind concept magnitudes to real carrier entities and select manifestations using their state; reject bare/unembedded concepts.
entries.explanation: Carrier-bound affect/trust fields are nearby representations, but none implements the general memeplex concept-to-physical-carrier magnitude and manifestation contract.
remaining_work: Add a carrier/concept/magnitude relation supporting books, objects and people, physical-carrier validation and zero influence for unembedded concepts; affect attribution is not a general meme carrier.

entries.old_contract: Property query → ordered updates to that property. Favor current rather than stale state.
entries.old_required_program: Resolve competing property updates by event time and validity; preserve negation, retractions, and actual-versus-hypothetical branches.
entries.explanation: Correction/retraction and scoped state-change fields can support removal of stale evidence while preserving its trace.
remaining_work: Add a generic chronological property resolver that distinguishes correction from real state change and restores the previous valid value after invalidation; suppression is not itself latest-state replay.

entries.old_contract: Action query → explicit prerequisites. Reweight success, failure, or preparation.
entries.old_required_program: Evaluate typed precondition expressions against persistent world state, returning missing prerequisites and their evidence rather than surface associations.
entries.explanation: Logical requirements and domain-specific access/causal prerequisites represent much of the old precondition data.
remaining_work: Add a typed action-precondition expression evaluator with conjunction, disjunction, negation, quantities and explicit unsupported-contract status.

entries.old_contract: Why-query or explanation → recorded cause edge. Favor an evidenced explanation.
entries.old_required_program: Follow recorded cause edges in the event graph, distinguish temporal neighbors from causes, and preserve multiple or unknown causes.
entries.explanation: Cause, mediation and joint-cause contracts retain event identity and separate attributed emotion causes from unqualified world causes.
remaining_work: Execute cause-graph traversal with provenance/branch validation; temporal neighbors and a character's explanation cannot silently become world cause edges.

entries.old_contract: Event-focused continuation → recorded resulting changes. Favor consequences already supported by the world.
entries.old_required_program: Traverse committed event-to-state effect edges, distinguish direct effects from inferred possibilities, and respect later invalidation.
entries.explanation: Explicit effect/state-delta contracts preserve resulting changes and distinguish an attempted event from a successful effect.
remaining_work: Implement event-to-state evidence retrieval and historical-versus-current validity, retaining multiple effect provenances without inventing compliance.

entries.old_contract: Two-event query → before/after relations. Favor consistent ordering words.
entries.old_required_program: Resolve partial temporal orders and interval relations; compute transitive precedence while detecting contradictions and incomparability.
entries.explanation: The catalog represents before/after relations, interval overlap, containment and ordering conflicts explicitly.
remaining_work: Add full partial-order closure, cycle detection and anchored calendar/day-boundary normalization; recognizing explicit temporal relations alone is not the complete old temporal solver.

entries.old_contract: Ongoing event → start time and elapsed interval. Downweight implausibly immediate completion.
entries.old_required_program: Compare elapsed time with typed duration models, units, environmental conditions, and uncertainty; avoid treating duration estimates as certainties.
entries.explanation: Duration and elapsed-time fields provide typed observations, and delayed-effect contracts keep stated delays causal.
remaining_work: Add condition-dependent duration distributions and elapsed-to-completion likelihoods; no authored field learns that drying or growth normally takes a given time.

entries.old_contract: Action query → actor's overlapping commitments. Downweight incompatible simultaneous actions.
entries.old_required_program: Perform interval/resource conflict checks for each actor and instrument, allowing compatible concurrent actions and distinguishing sequential events.
entries.explanation: Overlapping intervals, reserved resources and explicit dependency conflicts provide inputs for simultaneous-action checks.
remaining_work: Add actor/instrument capacity accounting and compatibility predicates over overlapping commitments, including release and uncertain intervals.

entries.old_contract: Current goal → reversible prior change and inverse action. Favor state-restoring actions.
entries.explanation: Inverse-action and reversibility contracts refine the old change-to-inverse lookup and separate compensation from restoration of the same object.
remaining_work: Implement the declared state/precondition match and return alternatives; an antonym or a replacement object does not prove a valid inverse.

entries.old_contract: Actor-focused continuation → unsatisfied goal record. Favor goal-relevant actions.
entries.old_required_program: Query actor-specific goal records, satisfaction predicates, priorities, and abandonment history; do not infer goals merely from adjacent nouns.
entries.explanation: The goal records bind owner, criterion, priority and lifecycle status, covering the intended actor-specific active-goal query.
remaining_work: Resolve current goal instances from visible updates and distinguish stated satisfaction judgments from independently verified world success.

entries.old_contract: Active goal → recorded obstacle. Favor resolving or routing around the blocker.
entries.old_required_program: Join active goals to failed prerequisites, causal obstacles, and alternative routes; distinguish a real blocker from incidental negative facts.
entries.explanation: Goal-linked obstacle records and physical/causal blockers distinguish a relevant dependency from an incidental negative fact.
remaining_work: Join each blocker to its goal and scoped evidence, remove superseded obstacles, and preserve belief-only blockers separately from actual barriers.

entries.old_contract: Current plan → first eligible unfinished step. Favor an executable next step.
entries.old_required_program: Maintain a dependency graph of plan steps with completion/failure states; return the eligible frontier without leaking future execution.
entries.explanation: The catalog represents an ordered plan and its next pending action, plus subgoals and contingencies.
remaining_work: Add dependency-DAG eligibility, multiple simultaneous frontier choices, cycle detection and resource conflict checks; a scalar next-step contract is narrower than the old frontier distribution.

entries.old_contract: Character viewpoint → their latest observation or report. Favor viewpoint-consistent statements.
entries.old_required_program: Maintain observer-indexed belief states updated only through witnessed events or reports; distinguish nested beliefs and world truth.
entries.explanation: Holder-indexed content, nested holders, source and revision contracts preserve belief scope separately from world truth.
remaining_work: Implement observer-specific evidence updates and latest applicable belief selection; another character's observation cannot update this holder automatically.

entries.old_contract: Knowledge query → visibility and presence at an event. Downweight unexplained knowledge.
entries.old_required_program: Evaluate perceptual/report access using event time, location, visibility, hearing, attention, and recorded communication paths.
entries.explanation: The catalog records physical perceptual access and holder-specific epistemic access, matching the distinction between seeing, hearing and being told.
remaining_work: Integrate event-time presence, attention, object identity uncertainty and communication paths; geometric visibility alone does not establish that someone noticed or learned a fact.

entries.old_contract: Conflicting report → source track record and directness. Reweight certainty and attribution.
entries.old_required_program: Combine source identity, directness, calibrated reliability history, and correlated reports; do not confuse confident language with truth.
entries.explanation: Source/directness/provenance fields represent the evidence needed to assess a report and avoid repeated-report corroboration.
remaining_work: Add calibrated source reliability history, dependence-aware weighting and conflict resolution; trust and confident wording are not reliability measurements.

entries.old_contract: Factual question → competing supported possibilities. Favor hedging or investigation over invented certainty.
entries.old_required_program: Represent competing supported hypotheses, normalize their weights, track missing evidence, and update them without inventing absent possibilities.
entries.explanation: Alternative hypotheses, missing evidence and conflict status retain ambiguity instead of forcing one invented answer.
remaining_work: Add normalized hypothesis weights and update rules with dependence correction and dimension-specific uncertainty; the listed alternatives currently carry no calibrated probability distribution.

entries.old_contract: Actor action query → active commitments to others. Favor fulfillment or explicitly motivated breach.
entries.old_required_program: Track promise events and their promisor, beneficiary, content, deadline, release, fulfillment, and conflicts with other obligations.
entries.explanation: Promise content, participants, lifecycle and deadlines decompose the old commitment record while distinguishing a private goal from an interpersonal obligation.
remaining_work: Implement active obligation resolution, conditions, release and conflicts; a fulfillment claim still needs its stated source and scope.

entries.old_contract: Quote continuation → current turn's speaker. Resolve first-person references consistently.
entries.old_required_program: Maintain a quotation/turn stack and speaker bindings, including nested quotations and reported speech; bind first person to the active speaker.
entries.explanation: Utterance/speaker and quote-shift records provide the bindings needed for first-person continuity.
remaining_work: Add the nested quotation/turn stack and persistence/pop rules; speaker extraction for one utterance does not by itself maintain an open turn.

entries.old_contract: Second-person reference → intended listener. Bind second-person descriptions.
entries.old_required_program: Resolve dialogue addressees from turn metadata, vocatives, group address, and nested quotations; retain ambiguity when not established.
entries.explanation: Resolved addressee sets, vocatives and quote-local reference shifts support the old second-person binding contract, including groups.
remaining_work: Keep generic you unresolved as an individual, distinguish a letter's recipient from a current listener, and retain ambiguity across nested turns.

entries.old_contract: Reply → unresolved question slot. Favor an answer to the actual question.
entries.old_required_program: Parse question focus into entity/event and requested role, maintain unresolved slots, and retrieve only answerable world/trace facts.
entries.explanation: Question slots, an open-question stack and scoped answer retrieval cover the semantic focus and follow-up anchors.
remaining_work: Add multi-slot answer composition and a strict answerability gate across world/trace properties; a requested slot alone does not supply a grounded answer.

entries.old_contract: Reply → previous speech act. Favor acceptance/refusal or acknowledgment.
entries.explanation: The catalog records speech acts and actual linked uptake, providing supervision for adjacency-pair behavior.
remaining_work: Add an expectation distribution over admissible response acts; observed acceptance is not evidence that an unresolved request must be accepted.

entries.old_contract: Current turn → disputed or corrected phrase. Favor the corrected referent.
entries.old_required_program: Track explicit conversational corrections and their scope, replacing disputed bindings while preserving who asserted each version.
entries.explanation: Explicit repair targets and correction links identify the old binding to weaken while preserving attribution and scope.
remaining_work: Resolve the corrected span/property and keep partial or quote-scoped corrections local; new referents must be grounded before a replacement is added.

entries.old_contract: Explanatory turn → overlap in interlocutors' knowledge. Reweight reminders versus explanations.
entries.old_required_program: Compute conversation common ground from participant-specific knowledge and acknowledgments; distinguish mutual knowledge from mere coincident beliefs.
entries.explanation: Acknowledged common-ground changes and holder-specific knowledge gaps match the inputs for shared-knowledge-sensitive explanation.
remaining_work: Add participant-set common-ground tracking across joins/leaves and reminders versus explanation policy; coincident beliefs are not automatically mutually established knowledge.

entries.old_contract: Dialogue continuation → speaker's communicative goal. Favor warning or apology language.
entries.explanation: Speech-act and intended-effect bindings provide a structured alternative to the old intention-to-language table.
remaining_work: Condition lexical realization on speaker, target and scope; sentence mood or a verb such as said alone cannot determine the intended act.

entries.old_contract: Next utterance → previous turn and response obligation. Favor a relevant respondent.
entries.old_required_program: Maintain turn order, explicit floor allocation, pending response obligations, interruptions, and multi-party ambiguity.
entries.explanation: Turn participants and response links are present, but no catalog head implements floor allocation or predicts next-speaker candidates from pending obligations.
remaining_work: Add a conversation agenda for floor claims, interruption, unavailable respondents, open-floor ambiguity and unresolved response duties.

entries.old_contract: Opening → missing participant/place/problem slots. Favor completing the premise.
entries.old_required_program: Track which premise slots are already grounded in the narrative/world and choose missing introductions without inventing a problem or duplicating exposition.
entries.explanation: The catalog identifies established scene, problem and participant evidence that can populate premise slots.
remaining_work: Add a prefix-grounded premise-completeness tracker and missing-slot policy; no current record proves the introduction is complete or licenses inventing an unstated problem.

entries.old_contract: Scene continuation → salient unfinished event. Favor returning to a live thread.
entries.old_required_program: Maintain persistent narrative threads with event IDs, resolution predicates, salience, scene relevance, and explicit abandonment.
entries.explanation: Thread identity/status, salience and topic return cover retrieval of a live unresolved issue across scenes.
remaining_work: Maintain resolution criteria and explicit abandonment per thread, deduplicate recurring mentions, and avoid treating silence as closure.

entries.old_contract: Actor description → emotion-changing events. Favor a state-consistent reaction.
entries.old_required_program: Read carrier-bound emotion updates and their causal provenance, with decay, intervening events, and mixed emotions.
entries.explanation: Affect is bound to an experiencer with scoped cause/change evidence and mixed components, preserving the central carrier/continuity distinction.
remaining_work: Add accumulated carrier magnitudes, supported decay/persistence and current-state resolution; attributed affect causes are not automatically committed world causes.

entries.old_contract: Actor action → current emotion and learned coping behavior. Favor grounded changes in emotional state.
entries.old_required_program: Match available coping actions to a carrier emotion and learned history, checking prerequisites and updating emotions only on committed events.
entries.explanation: The catalog records an explicitly used regulation strategy and the experiencer's coping assessment, giving grounded examples for learning.
remaining_work: Add available-strategy retrieval from actor history, feasibility checks and predicted effect distributions; a strategy annotation does not establish that it worked or is currently executable.

entries.old_contract: Interaction → pair's accumulated relationship state. Reweight disclosure, cooperation, or caution.
entries.old_required_program: Query directed pair-specific relationship magnitudes and history, then gate behavioral priors by actor, partner, and compatible commitments.
entries.explanation: Directed holder-target trust and relationship updates preserve pair-specific, domain-specific state.
remaining_work: Add history accumulation and a calibrated behavior prior jointly constrained by commitments; a trusted partner does not guarantee cooperation or disclosure.

entries.old_contract: Narrative midpoint → a change enabling a previously blocked option. Favor a consequential turn.
entries.old_required_program: Compare before/after world states and action eligibility to find consequential enabling changes, rather than choosing dramatic wording by keyword.
entries.explanation: Before/after changes, enabling conditions and explicit goal feasibility provide evidence for a consequential turn.
remaining_work: Add an action-eligibility comparison before and after the change and an event-level turn selector; a changed state or dramatic phrase alone is insufficient.

entries.old_contract: Closing passage → initial goal and present world state. Favor closure only when supported.
entries.old_required_program: Evaluate initial goals and active conflicts against terminal state, preserving partial success, failure, sacrifice, and unresolved obligations.
entries.explanation: Goal criteria, visible outcomes, unresolved threads and obligations supply a structured closure-verification route.
remaining_work: Evaluate actual outcomes against the original or explicitly revised criteria; keep partial success, grounded failure and remaining duties visible rather than trusting a happy closing phrase.

entries.old_contract: Ending → concrete objects whose states show the change. Favor an ending image that demonstrates the outcome.
entries.old_required_program: Select grounded physical carriers whose before/after states express the resolved change, with viewpoint and visibility checks.
entries.explanation: Concrete before/after state evidence and viewpoint visibility can support a demonstrative ending image.
remaining_work: Add an explicit physical-carrier image selector/ranker tied to the resolution; motif or closure annotations alone do not choose a grounded visible object.

entries.old_contract: Query predicate → matching past items only. Favor continuations grounded in the selected subset.
entries.old_required_program: Evaluate typed predicates over a dynamic candidate set, preserving conjunction, negation, missing values, and selection weights.
entries.explanation: Finite-domain, relation and proposition records can supply typed candidate sets and known restrictions.
remaining_work: Add a general predicate-AST evaluator with conjunction, scoped negation, missing-value semantics, deduplication and weighted all-match selection; the linked specific-domain contracts are not that generic filter.

entries.old_contract: Current relation pattern → analogous earlier role mapping. Favor the same role rather than the same surface token.
entries.old_required_program: Align relational frame roles across examples using variable bindings and type constraints, distinguishing role transfer from surface-token copying.
entries.explanation: Role-preserving analogy and slot-alignment contracts explicitly separate relational correspondence from copying a name or surface position.
remaining_work: Resolve both frames and typed role bindings, preserve ambiguous mappings and prohibit transfer of an unbound or merely hypothesized filler as fact.

entries.old_contract: Current word and active feature → matching corpus contexts. Apply a smoothed empirical probability adjustment.
entries.explanation: The new catalog can produce conditioning features and retrieve observed successors, but has no corpus-count table with smoothed feature-conditioned next-word probabilities.
remaining_work: Add empirical joint/count statistics, effective support, smoothing and a projection into the next-token distribution; native grammar weights are not those counts.

entries.old_contract: Candidate claim → facts inconsistent with it. Reduce unsupported candidates without automatically forbidding them.
entries.old_required_program: Evaluate candidate claims against typed world constraints and scoped evidence, with contradiction strength and modal/negation handling.
entries.explanation: Scoped contradictions, counterexamples and role exclusions cover several evidence-retrieval and suppression components.
remaining_work: Add candidate-specific graded counterevidence scoring across physical and behavioral constraints; unknown evidence is not contradiction and suppression must retain entity/time/scope identity.

entries.old_contract: Retrieved fact → age and intervening relevant events. Discount stale evidence.
entries.old_required_program: Compute evidence age relative to query time and invalidate it through intervening relevant events; use property-specific persistence models.
entries.explanation: Freshness explicitly compares observation time, query time and intervening relevant changes, matching the old distinction from report recency.
remaining_work: Implement property-specific persistence/invalidations and uncertainty; repeating an old observation must not refresh its age.

entries.old_contract: Active features → shared supporting event IDs. Avoid counting the same evidence three times.
entries.old_required_program: Group activations by shared provenance and estimate dependence before combining scores; do not treat different feature names as independent evidence.
entries.explanation: Provenance alignment and dependence-aware evidence union cover grouping repeated support and preserving correlated bindings.
remaining_work: Add quantitative dependence estimates and signed score combination; different feature names or observations of one event do not establish independent evidence.

entries.old_contract: Feature-conditioned predictor → effective sample support. Back off toward grammar/base statistics when evidence is sparse.
entries.old_required_program: Estimate effective sample support and fit hierarchical interpolation between trigram, bigram, and grammar priors; account for correlated counts.
entries.explanation: No new semantic attribute/head contract estimates effective sample size or fits hierarchical predictor interpolation.
remaining_work: Add effective-support statistics, learned trigram/bigram/grammar-prior backoff, domain-shift handling and held-out calibration without converting training labels into prefix evidence.

entries.old_contract: Query → whether any supported source exists. Apply no factual boost; favor supported uncertainty where appropriate.
entries.old_required_program: Determine whether required evidence is genuinely absent, contradicted, unavailable, or unparsed; decide when to communicate uncertainty rather than merely emitting no score.
entries.explanation: Missing premises, conflict, unresolved binding and a holder's knowledge gap distinguish several reasons for abstention.
remaining_work: Add a complete operational reason taxonomy including no table coverage, no legal grammar candidate, zero usable weight and inaccessible scope; current no-match semantics do not mean the world fact is unknown.
